boundary: Ed25519/DSSE verification observes the original envelope signature with the predeclared local public key. receiptBindingValid and signatureValid are separately labeled native server reports. No chain continuity or final-patch attestation is independently established. Signed selection commitments link to bodies only where signed_receipt_evidence reports a direct supported match; none of these checks establish truth, internal reasoning causation, trusted time, external key trust, completeness, or application correctness.

signed_receipt_evidence.boundary: Independent matching covers only direct signed IDs or direct SHA-256 equality against frozen UTF-8 bodies and response UUID mappings. Native-reported retrieved IDs are listed separately and do not make an opaque signed commitment reversible.
signed_receipt_evidence.reason: The signed payload contains opaque selection commitments and slots, but no supported direct body hash or evidence ID that reconstructs their body linkage.
